name: Neuroscience
boundaries: Neuroscience: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Mechanistic solution to the hard problem of consciousness
original_dispositions.reason: The historical impact statements about ethics, law, and artificial consciousness need further steps beyond the measurement-and-intervention account.

It is the unity-of-content requirement inside NEU-10, and sensory prostheses that would use a solution also need NEU-07. Treating binding as a second revolution would double-count one account of conscious content.

Storage, tagging, retrieval, readout, and write-in are one concept. Alzheimer’s reversal at the source is NEU-06 if the cells are already lost, and it is marked there as a further step when the original episode is gone.

original_dispositions.original_title: Master regulators of adult neuroplasticity and brain regeneration
original_dispositions.reason: Split, not dropped. The plasticity switch is added as NEU-11. Axon regrowth is NEU-05. Replacement of lost neurons is NEU-06. One historical sentence had bundled three barriers.

original_dispositions.original_title: Biological function of sleep and dreaming, including compressed sleep
original_dispositions.reason: Added as NEU-12 for the necessary functions of sleep and a shorter replacement. A full theory of dream narrative is not part of the completion test. It overlaps NEU-04 and NEU-10 if pursued separately.

original_dispositions.original_title: Neural implementation of semantic meaning and conceptual thought
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by NEU-03, with current partial language decoding recorded under NEU-04 and NEU-07. Thought-to-thought communication needs the code plus a write channel and is not credited as an automatic consequence.

original_dispositions.original_title: Neuroscience of free will and mental causation
original_dispositions.reason: The empirical fragment, whether a conscious intention has a causal role that can be measured and changed, sits inside NEU-10. Reform of legal responsibility is a social consequence, not a neuroscience capability at the calibration scale.

original_dispositions.original_title: Precise reversible mechanism of general anesthesia
original_dispositions.reason: Anesthesia already turns responsiveness off and on in routine care. Its mechanism remains unclear and is filed under NEU-10 as a component. A safer anesthetic would remain an improvement of an existing clinical capability unless it also delivered the content-selective account in NEU-10.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal neural code and canonical cortical computations
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by NEU-03. Complete brain simulation and a universal brain-machine interface also require NEU-01, NEU-02, and NEU-07.

original_dispositions.original_title: Dynamical laws of intelligence, insight, and creativity
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by NEU-03 insofar as those laws are the predictive theory of circuit computation. Engineered super-intelligence and faster scientific discovery are further claims and are not treated as direct consequences.

reconciliation_change_log.change: NEU-01 through NEU-10 are preserved with the same identities. No first-pass concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first-pass concepts are all retained.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Current state now includes Siegle and Steinmetz (May 2026).
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Thousands of spike trains are routine, and the whole-brain gap remains.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The canonical cortical code and semantic implementation are stated explicitly as parts of the same missing predictive theory.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Historical items on the neural code, meaning, and laws of intelligence are not separate discoveries.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The molecular-to-circuit storage mechanism is stated as the scientific core and content read/write as the demonstration.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: This covers the historical engram item without a second ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The overlap with salamander-like regeneration is flagged: axons versus replacement of lost neurons.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical bundle spans distinct barriers.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Unified perceptual content and the causal status of a reported intention are included. General anesthesia is recorded as an existing, mechanistically unsettled off-switch.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Binding and the empirical fragment of mental causation sit within the account; anesthesia is not evidence that consciousness is solved.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added reversible, circuit-specific reopening of critical-period plasticity in the adult brain.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first pass set aside a critical-period switch to keep a ten-item list. Adult, circuit-specific, reversible control is distinct from axon regrowth and neuron replacement. The November 2025 mouse amblyopia result shows one component and leaves the human, multi-circuit switch open.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added an account of sleep that lets its necessary brain functions be completed without a normal sleep period.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first pass set sleep aside as one bodily function. A replacement procedure does not yet exist, and the mechanism is still explicitly unsettled. Dream narrative and disease reversal are marked as further breakthroughs.
